title: Old alliance, new dynamics: Decoding the SAD-BJP reunion

ai.summary: The Shiromani Akali Dal (SAD) and Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) revived their political alliance after a six-year split, following the repeal of farm laws that led to SAD leader Harsimrat Kaur Badal's resignation from the Union cabinet in 2020.

facts.claim: SAD and BJP revived their political alliance after a six-year split
facts.quote: Six years after they parted ways over the Centre’s farm laws, the Shiromani Akali Dal (SAD) and the Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) on Tuesday buried the hatchet by reviving the alliance

facts.claim: SAD leader Harsimrat Kaur Badal resigned from the Union cabinet in 2020
facts.quote: That partnership unravelled in September 2020 when fierce protests by farmers across Punjab and Haryana against the BJP government’s three agricultural laws forced SAD leader Harsimrat Kaur Badal to resign from the Union cabinet

facts.claim: The alliance was formed after the repeal of farm laws
facts.quote: Even after Prime Minister Narendra Modi announced the repeal of the laws on November 19, 2021, the two parties remained apart.

ai.background_note: The SAD-BJP alliance revival follows the repeal of farm laws that caused SAD leader Harsimrat Kaur Badal to resign from the Union cabinet in 2020.
